title: Mekkor Alpha
author: Saytron3030
selftext:
This game is entirely generates by AI

\- Claude Code with Karpathy Wiki writing code and running playwright scripts in headless chromium grabbing screenshots every second

\- Google Nano Banana for assets. All prompts created by and called via API from Claude Code Harness

\- Eleven Labs for all sound design, once again called and prompted by the Harness over API

\- Adobe Illustrator. The only manual step creating turntables via a static image

I built this entire game from my phone, just a wild concept

https://mekkor.io
